description: Irreversibly undo pending changes for one path inside the selected workspace. Workspace-root undo is forbidden. Requires prepare/confirm. Returns a short-lived confirmation token.

itemPath.description: Path relative to UVCS_WORKSPACE. Use a specific file or directory; the workspace root is forbidden.

recursive.description: Undo pending changes recursively below itemPath. Default: false.

name: uvcs_undo_prepare
